transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
Lately I keep thinking my clients would be better off if I just weren’t here. Those thoughts about not wanting to wake up are starting to really scare me.
Have you had any thoughts about acting on those feelings, or do you have a plan to harm yourself?

Yes, on my worst day I actually wrote out a note on my phone and started looking up ways to kill myself. It really scared me that I was going that far, which is why I reached out to my coworker for help.
Have you felt this way before, or is this the first time you've experienced such intense sadness and thoughts?
No, I've never felt like this before. This is the first time I've ever experienced anything this dark or intense.
